item.title: Poll: About 6 in 10 Americans confident election will be fair and accurate
item.description: Most Americans lack confidence that Trump will accept midterm results if Republicans lose.

item.title: Iran claims closest-ever ties with Russia, contradicting Trump
item.description: Iran says relations with Russia are stronger than ever following a visit by Putin's top envoy, challenging Trump's claim that Moscow is not assisting Iran.

item.title: Iran live updates: Trump says US is winning war and 'can leave right now'
item.description: President Donald Trump announced "major combat operations" against Iran on Feb. 28.

item.title: Voters reject Alberta separation from Canada in referendum
item.description: The vote was not a referendum on independence from Canada, but it would have begun a process toward possible separation.
